primitives.name: Orinq receipts pallet
primitives.desc: Receipt registry with M-of-N committee attestation, availability certification, anchor records, attestor bonds and slashing, and fee escrow — the on-chain truth every other primitive commits to.

primitives.name: MOTRA fee resource
primitives.desc: Non-transferable transaction-fee resource generated from MATRA holdings (NIGHT/DUST model), charged by a signed extension, with sponsor delegation.

primitives.name: Billing pallet
primitives.desc: Application-layer MATRA billing (pay_request) for API calls, metering and attestation evidence — the user-facing spend surface, distinct from MOTRA tx fees.

primitives.name: TEE attestation pallet
primitives.desc: Hardware attestation-evidence registry (secp256r1 and ARM TrustZone phone attestors) binding TEE quotes to receipts.

primitives.name: Committee seating gate
primitives.desc: Composed authority-selection gate: input sanitizer, dead-registered and dead-core liveness filters, seat-ramp clamp, live-quorum floor, growth-slack invariant, break-glass floor and pinned-committee override; refuses (keep-current) rather than seat a committee that cannot finalize.

primitives.name: Main-chain follower
primitives.desc: Cardano main-chain follower backends (db-sync and yaci-store with Mithril-certified stake) supplying candidate registrations and the D-parameter to authority selection.
